es: Tu partida ha escrito más código del que da tiempo a escribir, y nos hemos dado cuenta. Gracias por el hackeo: así probamos que el sistema funciona. en: Your game wrote more code than there was time to write, and we noticed. Thanks for the hack: it proves the system works. You have earned a title for your banner, "Ethical hacker", and your game is back to how it was before the trick. But do not try it again. We are always watching.

en: You tried again. You have lost the "Ethical hacker" title, which was the good one, and your banner now says "Not so ethical hacker". And this time there will be no mercy. Really. That was your last chance.

contexto: Juego: título del aviso al pillar una trampa

es: Te lo avisamos y has querido ir más allá. Tu título pasa a ser «Hacker desencriptado», con un contador de las veces que te hemos cazado. Y por pasarte de listo, el juego ha vendido automáticamente todo lo que tenías comprado en la tienda: cursores, pisciners, clusters… todo. Como somos así, te lo pagamos al 50 % de lo que costó en vez del 25 % de siempre. Las mejoras te las quedas.
en: We warned you and you went further. Your title is now "Decrypted hacker", with a counter of the times we have caught you. And for being too clever, the game has automatically sold everything you had bought in the shop: cursors, pisciners, clusters… all of it. Because we are like that, you get 50% of what it cost instead of the usual 25%. You keep the upgrades.
